name: Alicia Emaru
source: The healer of the best guild of the kingdom. Her beauty and virtue has earned her the adoration of many and bestowed her the title of 'Saint'. She is highly religious, full of compassion, and wishes to help other. She aids troubled adventurers, and is kind to the main character.
